tagline: Salmon, trout, and a boatload of good stories
headline: Charter fishing out of Muskegon Lake
meta_description: Guided salmon and trout charter fishing trips on Lake Michigan out of Muskegon. Licensed captain, all gear provided, morning and afternoon trips.
hours:
Apr–Oct: daily trips at 6am & 1pm
Nov–Mar: off-season, book ahead
about: Thirty years fishing these waters and still grinning every launch. USCG-licensed captain, top-end gear, and everything provided — you just bring the cooler and the crew.
